description: A bungeecord/waterfall/velocity plugin to send chat messages between servers.

mods.name: SimpleProxyChatHelper
mods.description: Helper mod for SimpleProxyChat. Ensures mute plugins (e.g. LiteBans-Fabric) are respected before forwarding chat to the proxy.
